description: IBM i First Project — RPGLE ILE HTTPS State Viewer
author: Priya Ranjan

targets.name: MODULE
targets.command: CRTRPGMOD MODULE(RAIPX61/{member}) SRCFILE(RAIPX61/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR({member}) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(QILE) DBGVIEW(*LIST)

targets.name: MODULE
targets.command: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(RAIPX61/{member}) SRCFILE(RAIPX61/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR({member}) OBJTYPE(*MODULE) RPGPPOPT(*LVL2) COMPILEOPT('DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(QILE)')

targets.name: SRVPGM
targets.command: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(RAIPX61/HTTPSVCLIB) MODULE(RAIPX61/HTTPSVC) SRCFILE(RAIPX61/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(HTTPSVCBND) EXPORT(*ALL)
